title: Review of c09's active-gel no-division finding: replicated on seed 7 at zeta=45 with ks 0.05 and 0.03 (0 persistent splits; 66-72 nucleations, 32-49 merges)
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I read table.txt and ran world_z45.py unchanged (zeta=45, ks=0.05) and with ks=0.03 on new seed 7 (T=300; z45/, z45_ks03/). ks=0.05: 14 comets at the end, 35 tracks moving >= 1 body length (max 12.6), 4 splits, 0 persistent, 49 merges, 66 nucleations. ks=0.03: 11 comets, 21 moving tracks (max 9.7), 2 splits, 0 persistent, 32 merges, 72 nucleations. As claimed, the population is replenished by nucleation and thinned by fusion, with no division.

observations.finding: z45/seed7/FACTS.md: 0 persistent splits, 49 merges, 66 nucleations; z45_ks03/seed7/FACTS.md: 0 persistent splits, 32 merges, 72 nucleations

controls_run.finding: two scan points (ks 0.05, 0.03) on the same seed

verdicts.limitation: A negative over a scanned box (zeta 40-60, ks 0.02-0.05, Da 3-4); division could exist outside it. labkit's lineage window here is 20 frames = 20 t, short against comet lifetimes, but raw splits are only 2-4 per run, so the count of persistent splits is not the limiting factor.
